title: Advances in Artificial Intelligence (AI) Models and Generative Algorithms Represent a New Paradigm for Genomics Research.
authors: Lee, Du Hyeong; Park, Eun Gyung; Lee, Yun Ju; Jeong, Hyeon-Su; Roh, Hyun-Young; Jeong, Ga-Ram; Kim, Sang-Woo; Kim, Heui-Soo
one_liner_zh: 综述AI模型与生成算法在基因组学中的应用，涵盖TF结合位点预测等，但缺乏对TF-DNA互作机制与三维建模的深入聚焦，方法可迁移但深度有限。
abstract: Genomics has developed in step with progress in computing. As computational capabilities have grown, analyses have expanded from simple statistics to artificial intelligence (AI)-based approaches within genomics. The decline in sequencing costs has led to the accumulation of diverse genomic datasets, rapidly accelerating AI for genomic analysis. AI models are now developed and applied across many functional domains, including the prediction of transcription factor binding sites, epigenetic elements, DNA methylation, and noncoding sequence functional annotation. With the maturation of architectures such as deep neural networks, convolutional neural networks, recurrent neural networks, and transformers, many genomic models now accommodate longer inputs, capture long-range context, and integrate complex multi-omics data, thereby steadily improving predictive accuracy. Moreover, the emergence of generative AI has enabled models that can simulate and design genomic sequences. The introduction of generative AI into genomics goes beyond inferring function to the capability of replicating functional genomes. These advances will help advance genome interpretation and accelerate our ability to chart and navigate the genomic landscape.
abstract_zh: 基因组学与计算技术的进步同步发展。随着计算能力的增强，分析范围已从简单的统计学扩展至基因组学中基于人工智能（AI）的方法。测序成本的下降导致多样化基因组数据集的积累，迅速加速了AI在基因组分析中的应用。目前，AI模型已在多个功能领域开发和应用，包括转录因子结合位点预测、表观遗传元件、DNA甲基化以及非编码序列功能注释。随着深度神经网络、卷积神经网络、循环神经网络和Transformer等架构的成熟，许多基因组模型现在能够处理更长的输入，捕捉长程上下文，并整合复杂的多组学数据，从而稳步提高预测准确性。此外，生成式AI的出现使模型能够模拟和设计基因组序列。将生成式AI引入基因组学，超越了功能推断的范畴，具备了复制功能性基因组的能力。这些进展将有助于推进基因组解读，并加速我们绘制和导航基因组景观的能力。
